medium.$description: A toast appearing, an input field expanding.

grow.$description: Growth of today's tree when its stage rises (the forest, slice 6). The curve is motion.easing.enter. 0 under Reduce Motion: the tree jumps.

delay.$description: Delays are not animation but the time for a person to get there with the mouse. Reduce Motion does not zero them.

hide-actions.$description: The action row stays visible this long after the mouse leaves a feed row: you can reach an icon diagonally without losing the row.

enter.$description: Entering: a quick start, a soft stop.

reduced.$description: Duration values under Reduce Motion (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): transitions are instant. They are substituted over motion.duration.* in themes.css.
